    Help

    Getting started

    1. Drop files anywhere, or use Open. Several files at once are fine.
    2. For a picture or PDF of a chromatogram, use Image→data to digitize it. Digitized traces carry a digitized badge and ± uncertainty.
    3. Set smoothing, baseline and peak detection for the active trace in the sidebar. Results update as you go.
    4. Add the gradient and column under Method to get %B at elution, k′ and the gradient overlay.
    5. Click ⓘ next to any number in the peak table to see the formula and inputs behind it.

    , .Move the selected peak’s start bound one point left / right< >Move its end bound (Shift+, / Shift+.)

    Single-letter and punctuation shortcuts work only when focus is not in a text field, and can be turned off under Settings. Bounds can also be typed: open a peak’s ⓘ details and edit Start / End. To move integration bounds with the mouse, select a peak and drag its dotted boundary lines on the plot. Click a peak label or the plot title to rename it. With the plot focused, ←/→ move the cursor one point at a time (Shift for 10), and Enter sets a bound in Integrate mode.

    Privacy

    Peakly has no server. Files are read and processed inside this browser tab and are never uploaded. There are no analytics, trackers, cookies or accounts. The only things stored locally (in this browser’s storage, never sent anywhere) are your preferences: light/dark theme, the shortcut setting below and, when a feedback survey is configured, whether and when you were invited to it. The page loads pinned open-source libraries from public CDNs (Plotly, SheetJS, pako, lz-string, jsPDF, pdf.js). The one exception is the optional Claude image assist in the digitizer: if you start it, that image goes straight from your browser to the Anthropic API under your own API key. The key is held in memory only and is never saved. A share link keeps the data inside the URL fragment (#), which browsers don't send to any server.

    Settings

    • Turn off if you use speech input or keep pressing keys by accident. Ctrl/⌘ shortcuts, arrows and Delete stay on.
    • At most a few times, never during your work in a dialog. Nothing is sent unless you open the survey yourself.

    Saved in this browser only.

    Feedback

    Peakly is free and built by one scientist. Take the 3-minute feedback survey (opens in a new tab). It opens a Google Form in a new tab; Peakly itself sends nothing.

    About

    Peakly is free software (MIT) that runs entirely in your browser. It is independent of, and not affiliated with, any vendor or other chromatography project. Algorithms come from the published literature and are implemented from scratch.
